source.geometry_basis: SM_MPR_Conveyor2m: native X bounds +/-50 cm, side-frame width 7 cm, roller span +/-43 cm; roller center Z=100 cm, radius=3.5 cm, six radial segments => upper planar surface Z=100+3.5*sin(pi/3).

assumptions: Calibration aligns the current display geometry; it does not establish actual installation height, flow direction, or a PLC endpoint.
CAD source edge is preserved separately; calibrated pickup is the center of the 22x16x5 cm demonstration parcel, not a change to CAD geometry.
The 120 cm local queue and manual handoff are presentation choices; source evidence only establishes the inward shared-spine side.
Coverage tests use the current conveyor rail footprint and actual roller width. Normal individual roller gaps are not interpreted as missing conveyor.
